title: Ro Ro ke Bayan
body:
ro ro ke bayan karti thi ye zainab e nashaad
ay sayyade sajjad ay sayyade sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
ab hosh mein aao ke hua ghar mera barbaad
ay sayyade sajjad ay sayyade sajjad
<<DIVIDER>>
maare gaye abbas e dilawar labe darya
pamaal hua ran mein tere baap ka laasha
qaime bhi jale jal gaya masoom ka jhoola
jal jaaye ke jaan apni bachaye karo irshaad
ay sayyade sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai roti rahi akbar e mehroo gaye maare
bhai pe fida aun o mohamed huwe pyare
sab chup gaye is dasht mein aankhon ke sitare
chalti thi churi bahi pe mai karti thi faryaad
ay sayyade sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu ko mere choom ke baba ne kaha tha
ek roz rasan baazu mein baandhenge ye aada
mai kehti thi kyun kya mera abbas na hoga
reh reh ke mujhe baat yehi aati hai ab yaad
ay sayyade sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu kate abbas ke mai dekh rahi thi
naiza laga akbar ke kamar sheh ki jhuki thi
asghar ke laga teer qayamat ki ghadi thi
hai zakhm jo is dil pe nahi unki hai tadaad
ay sayyade sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay laal chalo yan se ke zindan ka safar hai
chadar ki jagah khaak bani zeenat e sar hai
aamada jafa par yahan har baani e shar hai
ab uth ke to dikhlao zara quwwat e ajdaad
ay sayyade sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
hona hai abhi tum ko bhi paband e salasil
rota hai tujhe dekh ke beta ye mera dil
ab jald chalo door bahot apni hai manzil
sehni hai bahot tum ko abhi raah mein uftaad
ay sayyade sajjad...
<<DIVIDER>>
rehaan tu is waqt faqad itni dua kar
is majlis e shabbir mein haathon ko utha kar
ay jaane nabi roohe nabi sibte payambar
mehshar mein sunaun mujhe nauha ye rahe yaad
ay sayyade sajjad...
author: Rehaan Azmi
